import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, cleanup, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from '@/lib/design/providers/ThemeProvider';

// Mock localStorage
const localStorageMock = (() => {
  let store: Record<string, string> = {};
  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => store[key] || null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      store[key] = value.toString();
    },
    removeItem: (key: string) => {
      delete store[key];
    },
    clear: () => {
      store = {};
    },
  };
})();

Object.defineProperty(global, 'localStorage', {
  value: localStorageMock,
});

// Mock CSS properties
const mockStyle = {
  setProperty: vi.fn(),
};

Object.defineProperty(document, 'documentElement', {
  writable: true,
  value: {
    style: mockStyle,
  },
});

describe('ThemeProvider - User Story 5', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorageMock.clear();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockStyle.setProperty.mockClear();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    cleanup();
    localStorageMock.clear();
  });

  describe('Basic Rendering', () => {
    it('should render children', async () => {
      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Test Content</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('Test Content')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
    });

    it('should prevent flash of unstyled content before mount', async () => {
      const { container } = render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Content</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('Content')).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(container.firstChild).not.toHaveStyle({ visibility: 'hidden' });
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Theme Context', () => {
    it('should provide theme context', async () => {
      let capturedContext: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        capturedContext = useTheme();
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedContext).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedContext.themeName).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedContext.tokens).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedContext.setTheme).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
        expect(capturedContext.availableThemes).toBeInstanceOf(Array);
      });
    });

    it('should throw error when useTheme is used outside provider', () => {
      const originalError = console.error;
      console.error = vi.fn();

      const TestComponent = () => {
        useTheme();
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      expect(() => render(<TestComponent />)).toThrow('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');

      console.error = originalError;
    });

    it('should provide default theme', async () => {
      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        capturedTheme = useTheme();
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme.themeName).toBe('zen');
      });
    });

    it('should provide theme tokens', async () => {
      let capturedTokens: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { tokens } = useTheme();
        capturedTokens = tokens;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTokens).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedTokens.colors).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedTokens.typography).toBeDefined();
        expect(capturedTokens.transition).toBeDefined();
      });
    });

    it('should provide available themes', async () => {
      let capturedThemes: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { availableThemes } = useTheme();
        capturedThemes = availableThemes;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedThemes.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(capturedThemes[0]).toHaveProperty('name');
        expect(capturedThemes[0]).toHaveProperty('label');
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Theme Switching', () => {
    it('should switch theme when setTheme is called', async () => {
      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName, setTheme } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <button onClick={() => setTheme('modern')}>Switch</button>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('zen');
      });

      const button = screen.getByText('Switch');
      button.click();

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('modern');
      });
    });

    it('should save theme to localStorage when changed', async () => {
      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { setTheme } = useTheme();
        return <button onClick={() => setTheme('modern')}>Switch</button>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider storageKey="test-theme">
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      const button = await screen.findByText('Switch');
      button.click();

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(localStorageMock.getItem('test-theme')).toBe('modern');
      });
    });
  });

  describe('localStorage Integration', () => {
    it('should load theme from localStorage on mount', async () => {
      localStorageMock.setItem('blog-theme', 'modern');

      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('modern');
      });
    });

    it('should use default theme when localStorage is empty', async () => {
      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('zen');
      });
    });

    it('should use custom storage key', async () => {
      localStorageMock.setItem('custom-key', 'modern');

      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider storageKey="custom-key">
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('modern');
      });
    });

    it('should ignore invalid theme in localStorage', async () => {
      localStorageMock.setItem('blog-theme', 'invalid-theme');

      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('zen');
      });
    });
  });

  describe('CSS Variables', () => {
    it('should apply CSS variables to document element', async () => {
      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Test</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });

    it('should apply color CSS variables', async () => {
      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Test</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--background', expect.any(String));
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--text-primary', expect.any(String));
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--accent', expect.any(String));
      });
    });

    it('should apply semantic color CSS variables', async () => {
      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Test</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--success-bg', expect.any(String));
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--error-text', expect.any(String));
      });
    });

    it('should apply typography CSS variables', async () => {
      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <div>Test</div>
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--font-display', expect.any(String));
        expect(mockStyle.setProperty).toHaveBeenCalledWith('--font-body', expect.any(String));
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Default Props', () => {
    it('should use default theme from config', async () => {
      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('zen');
      });
    });

    it('should override default theme with prop', async () => {
      let capturedTheme: any;

      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName } = useTheme();
        capturedTheme = themeName;
        return <div>Test</div>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="modern">
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(capturedTheme).toBe('modern');
      });
    });

    it('should use default storage key', async () => {
      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { setTheme } = useTheme();
        return <button onClick={() => setTheme('modern')}>Switch</button>;
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      const button = await screen.findByText('Switch');
      button.click();

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(localStorageMock.getItem('blog-theme')).toBe('modern');
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Theme Re-rendering', () => {
    it('should re-render children when theme changes', async () => {
      const TestComponent = () => {
        const { themeName, setTheme } = useTheme();
        return (
          <div>
            <div>Current theme: {themeName}</div>
            <button onClick={() => setTheme('modern')}>Switch</button>
          </div>
        );
      };

      render(
        <ThemeProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </ThemeProvider>
      );

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText(/Current theme:/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      });

      const button = screen.getByText('Switch');
      button.click();

      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('Current theme: modern')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
    });
  });
});

    11→export function generateSlug(text: string): string {

    13→    .toLowerCase()
    14→    .normalize('NFD')

    18→    .trim()

    20→    .replace(/-+/g, '-') // Replace multiple hyphens
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**

    25→ */
    26→export function formatDate(date: Date | string): string {

    31→  })
    32→}
    33→

    36→ */
    37→export function truncate(text: string, length: number): string {
    38→  if (text.length <= length) return text
    39→  return text.slice(0, length).trim() + '...'
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Generate excerpt from content

    45→export function generateExcerpt(content: string, length = 150): string {
    46→  // Remove markdown syntax

    48→    .replace(/#{1,6}\s/g, '')
    49→    .replace(/\*\*/g, '')
    50→    .replace(/\*/g, '')
    51→    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
    52→    .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
    53→    .trim()
    54→
    55→  return truncate(plainText, length)
    56→}

     1→/**
     2→ * Date Formatting Utilities
     3→ * Centralized date formatting for consistent display across the app
     4→ */
     5→
     6→export interface FormatDateOptions {
     7→  locale?: string
     8→  includeTime?: boolean
     9→  format?: 'full' | 'long' | 'medium' | 'short'
    10→}
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Format a date string to localized format
    14→ * @param dateString - ISO date string
    15→ * @param options - Formatting options
    16→ * @returns Formatted date string
    17→ */
    18→export function formatDate(
    19→  dateString: string | null | undefined,
    20→  options: FormatDateOptions = {}
    21→): string {
    22→  if (!dateString) {
    23→    return ''
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  const {
    27→    locale = 'vi-VN',
    28→    includeTime = false,
    29→    format = 'long'
    30→  } = options
    31→
    32→  const date = new Date(dateString)
    33→
    34→  // Handle invalid dates
    35→  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    36→    return ''
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const formatOptions: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {
    40→    year: 'numeric',
    41→    month: format === 'short' ? 'numeric' : 'long',
    42→    day: 'numeric',
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (includeTime) {
    46→    formatOptions.hour = '2-digit'
    47→    formatOptions.minute = '2-digit'
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  return date.toLocaleDateString(locale, formatOptions)
    51→}
    52→
    53→/**
    54→ * Format date with relative time (e.g., "2 days ago")
    55→ * @param dateString - ISO date string
    56→ * @returns Relative time string
    57→ */
    58→export function formatRelativeTime(dateString: string | null | undefined): string {
    59→  if (!dateString) return ''
    60→
    61→  const date = new Date(dateString)
    62→  const now = new Date()
    63→  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime()
    64→  const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000)
    65→  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000)
    66→  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000)
    67→
    68→  if (diffMins < 1) return 'Vừa xong'
    69→  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins} phút trước`
    70→  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours} giờ trước`
    71→  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays} ngày trước`
    72→
    73→  // Fall back to regular date for older posts
    74→  return formatDate(dateString)
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Format date range (e.g., "Jan 1 - Jan 31, 2024")
    79→ * @param startDate - Start date string
    80→ * @param endDate - End date string
    81→ * @returns Formatted date range
    82→ */
    83→export function formatDateRange(
    84→  startDate: string | null | undefined,
    85→  endDate: string | null | undefined
    86→): string {
    87→  if (!startDate || !endDate) return ''
    88→
    89→  const start = new Date(startDate)
    90→  const end = new Date(endDate)
    91→
    92→  if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime())) {
    93→    return ''
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  const options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {
    97→    year: 'numeric',
    98→    month: 'short',
    99→    day: 'numeric',
   100→  }
   101→
   102→  const startFormatted = start.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', options)
   103→  const endFormatted = end.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', options)
   104→
   105→  return `${startFormatted} - ${endFormatted}`
   106→}
   107→

     1→/**
     2→ * Content Formatting Utilities
     3→ * Content analysis and formatting helpers
     4→ */
     5→
     6→const WORDS_PER_MINUTE = 200
     7→const CHARS_PER_WORD = 5 // Average for Vietnamese
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * Calculate reading time for content
    11→ * @param content - Content to analyze
    12→ * @param wordsPerMinute - Average reading speed (default: 200)
    13→ * @returns Reading time string (e.g., "5 phút đọc")
    14→ */
    15→export function calculateReadingTime(
    16→  content: string | null | undefined,
    17→  wordsPerMinute: number = WORDS_PER_MINUTE
    18→): string {
    19→  if (!content || content.trim().length === 0) {
    20→    return '0 phút đọc'
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  // Remove HTML tags if present
    24→  const textContent = content.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim()
    25→
    26→  // Count words (split by whitespace for Vietnamese)
    27→  const words = textContent.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 0).length
    28→
    29→  // Calculate minutes
    30→  const minutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / wordsPerMinute))
    31→
    32→  return `${minutes} phút đọc`
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Generate excerpt from content
    37→ * @param content - Content to extract from
    38→ * @param maxLength - Maximum length (default: 500)
    39→ * @returns Generated excerpt
    40→ */
    41→export function generateExcerpt(
    42→  content: string | null | undefined,
    43→  maxLength: number = 500
    44→): string {
    45→  if (!content || content.trim().length === 0) {
    46→    return ''
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  // Remove HTML tags
    50→  const textContent = content.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim()
    51→
    52→  if (textContent.length <= maxLength) {
    53→    return textContent
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  // Truncate and add ellipsis
    57→  return textContent.slice(0, maxLength).trim() + '...'
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Check if content is HTML
    62→ * @param content - Content to check
    63→ * @returns True if content appears to be HTML
    64→ */
    65→export function isHtmlContent(content: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    66→  if (!content || content.trim().length === 0) {
    67→    return false
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  const trimmed = content.trim()
    71→  return trimmed.startsWith('<') && trimmed.endsWith('>')
    72→}
    73→
    74→/**
    75→ * Strip HTML tags from content
    76→ * @param content - Content with HTML
    77→ * @returns Plain text content
    78→ */
    79→export function stripHtml(content: string | null | undefined): string {
    80→  if (!content) return ''

    92→export function truncateContent(

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { cn, generateSlug, formatDate as formatDateUtil, truncate, generateExcerpt } from '@/lib/utils';

describe('Utils - Cross-Cutting Functions', () => {

    });

    it('should handle conditional classes', () => {
      expect(cn('foo', false && 'bar', 'baz')).toBe('foo baz');
    });

    it('should handle Tailwind conflicts', () => {
      expect(cn('p-4', 'p-2')).toBe('p-2');
    });

    it('should handle arrays of classes', () => {
      expect(cn(['foo', 'bar'], 'baz')).toBe('foo bar baz');
    });

    it('should handle objects with conditional classes', () => {
      expect(cn({ foo: true, bar: false, baz: true })).toBe('foo baz');
    });

    it('should handle empty inputs', () => {
      expect(cn()).toBe('');
    });

    it('should handle null and undefined', () => {
      expect(cn(null, undefined, 'foo')).toBe('foo');

      expect(cn('text-red-500', 'text-blue-500')).toBe('text-blue-500');
    });
  });

  describe('generateSlug() - URL-friendly Slugs', () => {
    it('should convert Vietnamese to ASCII', () => {

    });

    it('should convert đ to d', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('Đạo')).toBe('dao');
    });

    it('should handle special characters', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('Hello @World!')).toBe('hello-world');
    });

    it('should replace spaces with hyphens', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('hello world')).toBe('hello-world');
    });

    it('should handle multiple spaces', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('hello   world   test')).toBe('hello-world-test');
    });

    });

    it('should handle numbers', () => {

    });

    it('should convert to lowercase', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('HELLO WORLD')).toBe('hello-world');
    });

    it('should handle multiple hyphens', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('hello--world---test')).toBe('hello-world-test');
    });

    it('should handle Vietnamese complex text', () => {
      expect(generateSlug('Thiền tập mindfulness')).toBe('thien-tap-mindfulness');
    });

    it('should handle empty string', () => {

    it('should handle null end date', () => {

      expect(result).toBe('1 phút đọc');

    it('should calculate for longer content', () => {

      const result = calculateReadingTime(content);
      expect(result).toBe('2 phút đọc');
    });

    it('should use custom words per minute', () => {
      const content = 'word '.repeat(300);
      const result = calculateReadingTime(content, 100);
      expect(result).toBe('3 phút đọc');
    });

    it('should remove HTML tags before calculation', () => {
      const content = '<p>Hello world</p><p>Another paragraph</p>';
      const result = calculateReadingTime(content);
      expect(result).toBe('1 phút đọc');
    });

    it('should handle mixed HTML and text', () => {
      const content = '<div><h1>Title</h1><p>Content with many words here</p></div>';
      const result = calculateReadingTime(content);
      expect(result).toBe('1 phút đọc');
    });
  });

    });

    it('should return empty for empty string', () => {
      expect(generateExcerpt('')).toBe('');
    });

    it('should return full content if shorter than max length', () => {

    });

    });

    });

    it('should return 0 for whitespace only', () => {

    it('should count words correctly', () => {

    it('should handle multiple spaces', () => {

    it('should handle newlines', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('Line 1\nLine 2\nLine 3')).toBe(6);
    });

    it('should remove HTML tags before counting', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('<p>Hello world</p>')).toBe(2);

    it('should handle mixed content', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('<div>Title</div><p>Some content here</p>')).toBe(4);
    });

    it('should handle Vietnamese text', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('Chào mừng đến với thế giới thiền')).toBe(6);
    });

    it('should handle single word', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('Hello')).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should handle tabs and multiple whitespace types', () => {
      expect(getWordCount('Hello\t\tworld  \n  test')).toBe(3);
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Structured Data Generator
 * Generates JSON-LD structured data for SEO
 */

import { Post } from '@/lib/types/blog'

export interface ArticleStructuredData {
  '@context': string
  '@type': string
  headline: string
  description: string
  image: string[]
  author: {
    '@type': string
    name: string
  }
  publisher: {
    '@type': string
    name: string
    logo?: {
      '@type': string
      url: string
    }
  }
  datePublished: string
  dateModified?: string
  mainEntityOfPage?: {
    '@type': string
    '@id': string
  }
}

export interface BreadcrumbStructuredData {
  '@context': string
  '@type': string
  itemListElement: Array<{
    '@type': string
    position: number
    name: string
    item?: string
  }>
}

export interface WebsiteStructuredData {
  '@context': string
  '@type': string
  name: string
  url: string
  description: string
  potentialAction?: {
    '@type': string
    target: string
    'query-input': string
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Article structured data for a blog post
 */
export function generateArticleStructuredData(
  post: Post,
  siteUrl: string = 'https://zenblog.example.com'
): ArticleStructuredData {
  const imageUrl = post.cover_image
    ? `${siteUrl}${post.cover_image}`
    : `${siteUrl}/og-image.jpg`

  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Article',
    headline: post.title,
    description: post.excerpt || '',
    image: [imageUrl],
    author: {
      '@type': 'Person',
      name: post.author?.name || 'Zen Blogger',
    },
    publisher: {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: 'Zen Blog',
      logo: {
        '@type': 'ImageObject',
        url: `${siteUrl}/logo.png`,
      },
    },
    datePublished: post.created_at,
    dateModified: post.updated_at,
    mainEntityOfPage: {
      '@type': 'WebPage',
      '@id': `${siteUrl}/posts/${post.slug}`,
    },
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Breadcrumb structured data
 */
export function generateBreadcrumbStructuredData(
  items: Array<{ name: string; url?: string }>,
  siteUrl: string = 'https://zenblog.example.com'
): BreadcrumbStructuredData {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
      '@type': 'ListItem',
      position: index + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: item.url ? `${siteUrl}${item.url}` : undefined,
    })),
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Website structured data for search
 */
export function generateWebsiteStructuredData(
  siteUrl: string = 'https://zenblog.example.com'
): WebsiteStructuredData {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'WebSite',
    name: 'Zen Blog',
    url: siteUrl,
    description: 'Blog chia sẻ về thiền tập, mindfulness, và tìm kiếm inner peace',
    potentialAction: {
      '@type': 'SearchAction',
      target: `${siteUrl}/search?q={search_term_string}`,
      'query-input': 'required name=search_term_string',
    },
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Blog structured data
 */
export function generateBlogStructuredData(
  posts: Post[],
  siteUrl: string = 'https://zenblog.example.com'
) {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Blog',
    name: 'Zen Blog',
    description: 'Blog chia sẻ về thiền tập, mindfulness',
    url: siteUrl,
    blogPost: posts.map((post) => ({
      '@type': 'BlogPosting',
      headline: post.title,
      url: `${siteUrl}/posts/${post.slug}`,
      datePublished: post.created_at,
      dateModified: post.updated_at,
      author: {
        '@type': 'Person',
        name: post.author?.name || 'Zen Blogger',
      },
    })),
  }
}

/**

import { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const baseUrl = 'https://zenblog.example.com'

  // Static routes
  const routes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    {
      url: baseUrl,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 1,
    },
    {
      url: `${baseUrl}/about`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.8,
    },
    {
      url: `${baseUrl}/search`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'weekly',
      priority: 0.6,
    },
  ]

  // TODO: Add dynamic blog posts to sitemap

}

/**

 */

import { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  const baseUrl = 'https://zenblog.example.com'

  return {
    rules: [
      {
        userAgent: '*',
        allow: '/',
        disallow: ['/admin/', '/api/'],
      },
    ],
    sitemap: `${baseUrl}/sitemap.xml`,
  }
}

     7→export async function getPublishedPosts(
     8→  params: PaginationParams = {}
     9→): Promise<PaginatedResult<PostWithCategories>> {
    10→  const { limit = 20, cursor } = params
    11→  const supabase = await createClient()
    12→
    13→  let query = supabase
    14→    .from('posts')

    21→        excerpt,

    23→        status,

    36→    .eq('status', POST_STATUS.PUBLISHED)
    37→    .order('published_at', { ascending: false })
    38→    .limit(limit + 1) // Fetch one extra to check if there's more
    39→
    40→  if (cursor) {
    41→    // Use cursor as continuation point
    42→    query = query.lt('published_at', cursor)
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const { data, error, count } = await query
    46→
    47→  if (error) {

    50→  }
    51→
    52→  const hasMore = data && data.length > limit

    62→
    63→  return {
    64→    data: validationResult.data,
    65→    count: count || 0,
    66→    hasMore,
    67→    nextCursor: hasMore ? posts[posts.length - 1].published_at : undefined,
    68→  }
    69→}

   347→/**
   348→ * Search posts by query string
   349→ * Searches in title, content, and excerpt (case-insensitive)
   350→ */
   351→export async function searchPosts(
   352→  query: string,
   353→  params: PaginationParams = {}
   354→): Promise<PaginatedResult<PostWithCategories>> {
   355→  if (!query || query.trim().length === 0) {
   356→    return { data: [], count: 0, hasMore: false }
   357→  }
   358→
   359→  const { limit = 20, cursor } = params
   360→  const supabase = await createClient()
   361→  const searchTerm = query.trim().slice(0, 100) // Limit input length for security
   362→
   363→  // Use Postgres full-text search with ilike for Vietnamese support
   364→  let searchQuery = supabase
   365→    .from('posts')
   366→    .select(
   367→      `
   368→        id,
   369→        title,
   370→        slug,
   371→        content,
   372→        excerpt,
   373→        cover_image,
   374→        status,
   375→        published_at,
   376→        created_at,
   377→        updated_at,
   378→        categories (
   379→          id,
   380→          name,
   381→          slug,
   382→          description
   383→        )
   384→      `,
   385→      { count: 'exact' }
   386→    )
   387→    .eq('status', POST_STATUS.PUBLISHED)
   388→    .or(`title.ilike.%${searchTerm}%,content.ilike.%${searchTerm}%,excerpt.ilike.%${searchTerm}%`)
   389→    .order('published_at', { ascending: false })
   390→    .limit(limit + 1) // Fetch one extra to check if there's more
   391→
   392→  if (cursor) {
   393→    // Use cursor as continuation point
   394→    searchQuery = searchQuery.lt('published_at', cursor)
   395→  }
   396→
   397→  const { data, error, count } = await searchQuery
   398→
   399→  if (error) {
   400→    console.error('Error searching posts:', error)
   401→    return { data: [], count: 0, hasMore: false }
   402→  }
   403→
   404→  const hasMore = data && data.length > limit
   405→  const posts = hasMore ? data.slice(0, limit) : (data || [])
   406→
   407→  // Validate with zod
   408→  const validationResult = PostWithCategoriesSchema.array().safeParse(posts)
   409→
   410→  if (!validationResult.success) {
   411→    console.error('Data validation failed:', validationResult.error)
   412→    return { data: [], count: 0, hasMore: false }
   413→  }
   414→
   415→  return {
   416→    data: validationResult.data,
   417→    count: count || 0,
   418→    hasMore,
   419→    nextCursor: hasMore ? posts[posts.length - 1].published_at : undefined,

   200→    // Revalidate paths
   201→    revalidatePath('/')
   202→    revalidatePath('/admin/posts')
   203→    revalidatePath(`/admin/posts/${id}/edit`)
   204→    if (slug) {

   206→    }

   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Soft delete a blog post
   220→ */
   221→export async function deletePost(id: string) {
   222→  const supabase = await createClient()
   223→
   224→  try {
   225→    // Get current user
   226→    const {
   227→      data: { user },
   228→    } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
   229→
   230→    if (!user) {
   231→      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }
   232→    }
   233→
   234→    // Get post slug and author_id before deleting for revalidation and auth check
   235→    const { data: existingPost } = await supabase
   236→      .from('posts')
   237→      .select('slug, author_id')
   238→      .eq('id', id)
   239→      .single()
   240→
   241→    if (!existingPost) {
   242→      return { success: false, error: 'Post not found' }
   243→    }
   244→
   245→    // Verify user owns this post
   246→    if (existingPost.author_id !== user.id) {
   247→      return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: You can only delete your own posts' }
   248→    }
   249→
   250→    // Soft delete by setting deleted_at
   251→    const { error } = await supabase
   252→      .from('posts')
   253→      .update({ deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() })
   254→      .eq('id', id)
   255→
   256→    if (error) {
   257→      console.error('Error deleting post:', error)
   258→      return { success: false, error: error.message }
   259→    }
   260→
   261→    // Revalidate paths
   262→    revalidatePath('/')
   263→    revalidatePath('/admin/posts')
   264→    revalidatePath(`/posts/${existingPost.slug}`)
   265→
   266→    return { success: true }
   267→  } catch (error) {
   268→    console.error('Error in deletePost:', error)
   269→    return {
   270→      success: false,
   271→      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
   272→    }
   273→  }
   274→}

     8→/**
     9→ * Generate URL-friendly slug from Vietnamese text
    10→ */
    11→export function generateSlug(text: string): string {
    12→  return text
    13→    .toLowerCase()
    14→    .normalize('NFD')
    15→    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '') // Remove diacritics
    16→    .replace(/đ/g, 'd')
    17→    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '') // Remove special chars
    18→    .trim()
    19→    .replace(/\s+/g, '-') // Replace spaces with hyphens
    20→    .replace(/-+/g, '-') // Replace multiple hyphens
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Format date to Vietnamese locale
    25→ */
    26→export function formatDate(date: Date | string): string {
    27→  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', {
    28→    year: 'numeric',
    29→    month: 'long',
    30→    day: 'numeric',
    31→  })
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Truncate text to specified length
    36→ */
    37→export function truncate(text: string, length: number): string {
    38→  if (text.length <= length) return text
    39→  return text.slice(0, length).trim() + '...'
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Generate excerpt from content
    44→ */
    45→export function generateExcerpt(content: string, length = 150): string {
    46→  // Remove markdown syntax
    47→  const plainText = content
    48→    .replace(/#{1,6}\s/g, '')
    49→    .replace(/\*\*/g, '')
    50→    .replace(/\*/g, '')
    51→    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
    52→    .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
    53→    .trim()
    54→
    55→  return truncate(plainText, length)
    56→}
    57→

# Blog API Documentation

This document describes the core API functions for querying and managing blog content.

## Table of Contents

- [Query Functions](#query-functions)
  - [Public Queries](#public-queries)
  - [Admin Queries](#admin-queries)
- [Action Functions](#action-functions)
- [Utility Functions](#utility-functions)
- [Type Definitions](#type-definitions)

---

## Query Functions

Query functions are read-only operations that fetch data from the database. They are located in `lib/blog/queries.ts`.

### Public Queries

#### `getPublishedPosts`

Fetches published posts with pagination support.

\```typescript
import { getPublishedPosts } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const result = await getPublishedPosts({ limit: 20 })

console.log(result.data)        // Array of posts
console.log(result.count)       // Total count
console.log(result.hasMore)     // Boolean
console.log(result.nextCursor)  // ISO timestamp for next page
\```

**Parameters:**
- `params.limit` - Maximum posts to return (default: 20)
- `params.cursor` - Pagination cursor (ISO timestamp)

**Returns:** `PaginatedResult<PostWithCategories>`

---

#### `getPostBySlug`

Fetches a single published post by its URL slug.

\```typescript
import { getPostBySlug } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

try {
  const post = await getPostBySlug('hello-world')
  console.log(post.title)
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof PostNotFoundError) {
    // Post not found
  }
}
\```

**Parameters:**
- `slug` - The unique URL slug of the post

**Returns:** `PostWithCategories`

**Throws:**
- `PostNotFoundError` - When the post doesn't exist
- `DatabaseError` - When database query fails

---

#### `getAllCategories`

Fetches all categories ordered alphabetically.

\```typescript
import { getAllCategories } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const categories = await getAllCategories()
\```

**Returns:** `Category[]`

---

#### `getCategoryBySlug`

Fetches a single category by its URL slug.

\```typescript
import { getCategoryBySlug } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const category = await getCategoryBySlug('buddhism')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `slug` - The unique URL slug of the category

**Returns:** `Category`

**Throws:**
- `CategoryNotFoundError` - When the category doesn't exist
- `DatabaseError` - When database query fails

---

#### `getPostsByCategory`

Fetches all published posts in a specific category.

\```typescript
import { getPostsByCategory } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const posts = await getPostsByCategory('buddhism')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `categorySlug` - The unique URL slug of the category

**Returns:** `PostWithCategories[]`

---

#### `getAllCategoriesWithPostCount`

Fetches all categories with the number of published posts in each.

\```typescript
import { getAllCategoriesWithPostCount } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const categories = await getAllCategoriesWithPostCount()
categories.forEach(cat => {
  console.log(`${cat.name}: ${cat.post_count} posts`)
})
\```

**Returns:** `CategoryWithPostCount[]`

---

#### `searchPosts`

Performs full-text search across published posts.

\```typescript
import { searchPosts } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const results = await searchPosts('meditation', { limit: 10 })
\```

**Parameters:**
- `query` - The search term
- `params.limit` - Maximum results to return (default: 20)
- `params.cursor` - Pagination cursor

**Returns:** `PaginatedResult<PostWithCategories>`

---

### Admin Queries

#### `getAllPosts`

Fetches all posts (including drafts) for admin.

\```typescript
import { getAllPosts } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

// Get all posts
const allPosts = await getAllPosts()

// Get only published
const published = await getAllPosts('published')

// Get only drafts
const drafts = await getAllPosts('draft')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `status` - Optional status filter ('draft' or 'published')

**Returns:** `PostWithCategories[]`

---

#### `getPostById`

Fetches a post by ID for admin editing.

\```typescript
import { getPostById } from '@/lib/blog/queries'

const post = await getPostById('post-id-here')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `id` - The unique ID of the post

**Returns:** `PostWithCategories | null`

---

## Action Functions

Action functions modify data in the database. They are Server Actions located in `lib/blog/actions.ts` and require authentication.

### `createPost`

Creates a new blog post.

\```typescript
import { createPost } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const result = await createPost({
  title: 'My First Post',
  content: '<p>Hello world!</p>',
  status: 'DRAFT',
  category_ids: ['cat-1', 'cat-2']
})

if (result.success) {
  console.log('Created post:', result.data.id)
} else {
  console.error('Error:', result.error)
}
\```

**Parameters:**
- `data.title` - Post title
- `data.content` - Post content (HTML/TipTap format)
- `data.slug` - Optional URL slug (auto-generated if not provided)
- `data.excerpt` - Optional excerpt (auto-generated if not provided)
- `data.cover_image` - Optional cover image URL
- `data.status` - Post status ('DRAFT' or 'PUBLISHED')
- `data.category_ids` - Optional array of category IDs

**Returns:** `{ success: boolean, data?: Post, error?: string, warning?: string }`

---

### `updatePost`

Updates an existing blog post.

\```typescript
import { updatePost } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const result = await updatePost({
  id: 'post-123',
  title: 'Updated Title',
  status: 'PUBLISHED',
  category_ids: ['cat-1']
})
\```

**Parameters:**
- `data.id` - Post ID to update
- `data.title` - Optional new title
- `data.content` - Optional new content
- `data.slug` - Optional new slug
- `data.excerpt` - Optional new excerpt
- `data.cover_image` - Optional new cover image URL
- `data.status` - Optional new status
- `data.category_ids` - Optional new array of category IDs

**Returns:** `{ success: boolean, data?: Post, error?: string, warning?: string }`

---

### `deletePost`

Soft deletes a blog post.

\```typescript
import { deletePost } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const result = await deletePost('post-123')

if (result.success) {
  console.log('Post deleted successfully')
}
\```

**Parameters:**
- `id` - Post ID to delete

**Returns:** `{ success: boolean, error?: string }`

---

### `publishPost`

Publishes a draft post.

\```typescript
import { publishPost } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const result = await publishPost('post-123')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `id` - Post ID to publish

**Returns:** `{ success: boolean, error?: string }`

---

### `unpublishPost`

Unpublishes a post (changes to draft).

\```typescript
import { unpublishPost } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const result = await unpublishPost('post-123')
\```

**Parameters:**
- `id` - Post ID to unpublish

**Returns:** `{ success: boolean, error?: string }`

---

### `getCategoriesForAdmin`

Fetches all categories for admin forms.

\```typescript
import { getCategoriesForAdmin } from '@/lib/blog/actions'

const categories = await getCategoriesForAdmin()
\```

**Returns:** `Category[]`

---

## Utility Functions

Utility functions are located in `lib/utils.ts`.

### `cn`

Merge Tailwind CSS classes with proper precedence.

\```typescript
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Simple usage
cn('px-4', 'py-2', 'bg-blue-500')

// With conditional classes
cn('base-class', isActive && 'active-class')

// With conflicting classes (later wins)
cn('px-4', 'px-8') // => 'px-8'
\```

---

### `generateSlug`

Generate URL-friendly slug from Vietnamese text.

\```typescript
import { generateSlug } from '@/lib/utils'

generateSlug('Chào mừng đến với Việt Nam')
// => 'chao-mung-den-voi-viet-nam'

generateSlug('Thiền & Mindfulness')
// => 'thien-mindfulness'
\```

---

### `formatDate`

Format date to Vietnamese locale.

\```typescript
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/utils'

formatDate(new Date('2024-01-15'))
// => '15 tháng 1, 2024'
\```

---

### `truncate`

Truncate text to specified length.

\```typescript
import { truncate } from '@/lib/utils'

truncate('Hello world', 5)
// => 'Hello...'

truncate('Short', 10)
// => 'Short'
\```

---

### `generateExcerpt`

Generate excerpt from HTML/Markdown content.

\```typescript
import { generateExcerpt } from '@/lib/utils'

generateExcerpt('# Hello World\n\nThis is **bold** text.')
// => 'Hello World This is bold text.'
\```

---

## Type Definitions

Key types used throughout the API.

\```typescript
// Post types
interface Post {
  id: string
  title: string
  slug: string
  content: string
  excerpt: string
  cover_image: string | null
  status: PostStatus
  published_at: string | null
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

interface PostWithCategories extends Post {
  categories: Category[]
}

type PostStatus = 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED'

// Category types
interface Category {
  id: string
  name: string
  slug: string
  description: string | null
}

interface CategoryWithPostCount extends Category {
  post_count: number
}

// Pagination types
interface PaginatedResult<T> {
  data: T[]
  count: number
  hasMore: boolean
  nextCursor?: string
}

interface PaginationParams {
  limit?: number
  cursor?: string
}

// Action types
interface CreatePostData {
  title: string
  content: string
  slug?: string
  excerpt?: string
  cover_image?: string | null
  status: PostStatus
  category_ids?: string[]
}

interface UpdatePostData {
  id: string
  title?: string
  content?: string
  slug?: string
  excerpt?: string
  cover_image?: string | null
  status?: PostStatus
  category_ids?: string[]
}
\```

---

## Error Handling

### Error Types

\```typescript
class PostNotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(slug: string)
}

class CategoryNotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(slug: string)
}

class DatabaseError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown)
}
\```

### Action Result Pattern

All action functions return a result object:

\```typescript
interface ActionResult<T = unknown> {
  success: boolean
  data?: T
  error?: string
  warning?: string
}
\```

Always check `success` before accessing `data`:

\```typescript
const result = await createPost(data)

if (result.success) {
  // Access result.data
  console.log(result.data)
} else {
  // Handle error
  console.error(result.error)
}
\```

---

## Best Practices

1. **Always handle errors** - Use try/catch for queries and check `success` for actions
2. **Use pagination** - For large datasets, use cursor-based pagination
3. **Validate inputs** - Action functions include server-side validation
4. **Check authentication** - Action functions verify user ownership
5. **Revalidate paths** - Actions automatically revalidate Next.js cache

---

## Import Examples

\```typescript
// Query functions
import {
  getPublishedPosts,
  getPostBySlug,
  getAllCategories,
  searchPosts
} from '@/lib/blog/queries'

// Action functions
import {
  createPost,
  updatePost,
  deletePost,
  publishPost
} from '@/lib/blog/actions'

// Utilities
import {
  cn,
  generateSlug,
  formatDate,
  truncate,
  generateExcerpt
} from '@/lib/utils'

// Types
import type {
  Post,
  PostWithCategories,
  Category,
  PaginatedResult
} from '@/lib/types/blog'
\```

     1→# Blog Thiền - Personal Blog Platform
     2→
     3→A modern, minimalist personal blog built with Next.js 15, Supabase, and TypeScript. Features a Zen-inspired design theme with support for multiple themes and a clean reading experience.
     4→
     5→## Tech Stack
     6→
     7→- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
     8→- **Language**: TypeScript 5.x
     9→- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
    10→- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
    11→- **Editor**: TipTap (rich text editor)
    12→- **UI Components**: Custom design system with theme switching
    13→
    14→## Features
    15→
    16→- ✅ **Zen Theme**: Warm, book-like aesthetic inspired by traditional Vietnamese minimalism
    17→- ✅ **Theme System**: Runtime theme switching with Design Tokens
    18→- ✅ **Rich Text Editor**: TipTap editor with formatting, lists, code blocks, tables, images, and more
    19→- ✅ **Category System**: Organize posts by categories
    20→- ✅ **Search**: Full-text search across posts
    21→- ✅ **Pagination**: Efficient pagination for large datasets
    22→- ✅ **Type Safety**: Zod schema validation at runtime
    23→- ✅ **Authentication**: Supabase Auth for admin users
    24→- ✅ **SEO**: Optimized metadata and semantic HTML
    25→

   137→## Environment Setup
   138→
   139→### Required Environment Variables
   140→
   141→Create a `.env` file in the project root with the following variables:
   142→
   143→```env
   144→# Supabase (Required)
   145→NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your-supabase-url
   146→NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-supabase-anon-key
   147→
   148→# Optional: Sentry (Error Tracking)
   149→SENTRY_DSN=your-sentry-dsn
   150→SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=your-sentry-auth-token
   151→
   152→# Optional: Google Analytics
   153→NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID=your-google-analytics-id
   154→
   155→# Environment
   156→NODE_ENV=development
   157→```
   158→
   159→### Getting Supabase Credentials
   160→
   161→1. Go to [Supabase](https://supabase.com) and create a new project
   162→2. Navigate to **Project Settings** → **API**
   163→3. Copy the following:
   164→   - **Project URL** → `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`
   165→   - **anon/public key** → `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
   166→
   167→### Database Migration
   168→
   169→After setting up Supabase, run the migration to create the required tables:
   170→
   171→1. Go to **SQL Editor** in your Supabase dashboard
   172→2. Create a new query and paste the contents of:
   173→   - `supabase/migrations/20240110000000_categories_with_post_count.sql`
   174→3. Run the query to create tables and functions
   175→
   176→### Creating an Admin User
   177→
   178→1. Go to **Authentication** → **Users** in Supabase
   179→2. Click "Add user" and create a new user
   180→3. Set the user's email as confirmed
   181→4. This user can now access the admin panel at `/admin`
   182→
   183→---
   184→
   185→## Testing
   186→
   187→This project uses Vitest for unit testing and Playwright for E2E testing.
   188→
   189→### Running Tests
   190→
   191→```bash
   192→# Run all unit tests
   193→npm run test:unit
   194→
   195→# Run unit tests in watch mode
   196→npm run test:watch
   197→
   198→# Run unit tests with coverage
   199→npm run test:coverage
   200→
   201→# Run E2E tests
   202→npm run test:e2e
   203→
   204→# Run all tests (unit + E2E)
   205→npm run test
   206→
   207→# Run TypeScript check
   208→npm run type-check
   209→
   210→# Run ESLint
   211→npm run lint
   212→```
   213→
   214→### Test Structure
   215→
   216→```
   217→tests/
   218→├── unit/                 # Unit tests (Vitest)
   219→│   ├── components/       # Component tests
   220→│   ├── lib/              # Library function tests
   221→│   ├── setup.ts          # Test configuration
   222→│   └── mocks/            # Mock implementations
   223→└── e2e/                  # E2E tests (Playwright)
   224→    ├── create-post.spec.ts
   225→    ├── search.spec.ts
   226→    └── admin-posts-list.spec.ts
   227→```
   228→
   229→### Writing Unit Tests
   230→
   231→```typescript
   232→import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
   233→import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
   234→import { MyComponent } from '@/components/MyComponent'
   235→
   236→describe('MyComponent', () => {
   237→  it('should render correctly', () => {
   238→    render(<MyComponent />)
   239→    expect(screen.getByText('Hello')).toBeInTheDocument()
   240→  })
   241→})
   242→```
   243→
   244→### Test Coverage
   245→
   246→The project maintains high test coverage. To view coverage reports:
   247→
   248→```bash
   249→npm run test:coverage
   250→open coverage/index.html
   251→```
   252→
   253→---
   254→
   255→## Deployment
   256→
   257→### Deploying to Vercel
   258→
   259→1. **Install Vercel CLI** (optional):
   260→```bash
   261→npm i -g vercel
   262→```
   263→
   264→2. **Deploy**:
   265→```bash
   266→vercel
   267→```
   268→
   269→3. **Set Environment Variables** in Vercel:
   270→   - Go to **Settings** → **Environment Variables**
   271→   - Add all required variables from the `.env` file
   272→
   273→4. **Deploy**:
   274→   - Connect your GitHub repository to Vercel
   275→   - Vercel will automatically deploy on push to `main` branch
   276→   - Configure build settings:
   277→     - **Build Command**: `npm run build`
   278→     - **Output Directory**: `.next`
   279→     - **Install Command**: `npm install`
   280→
   281→### Deploying to Other Platforms
   282→
   283→#### Docker
   284→
   285→```dockerfile
   286→FROM node:18-alpine
   287→
   288→WORKDIR /app
   289→
   290→COPY package*.json ./
   291→RUN npm ci --only=production
   292→
   293→COPY . .
   294→RUN npm run build
   295→
   296→EXPOSE 3000
   297→
   298→CMD ["npm", "start"]
   299→```
   300→
   301→Build and run:
   302→```bash
   303→docker build -t blog-zen .
   304→docker run -p 3000:3000 -e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=... -e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=... blog-zen
   305→```
   306→
   307→#### Static Export (Optional)
   308→
   309→For static hosting, configure `next.config.js`:
   310→
   311→```javascript
   312→module.exports = {
   313→  output: 'export',
   314→}
   315→```
   316→
   317→Then build:
   318→```bash
   319→npm run build
   320→# Output in 'out' directory
   321→```
   322→
   323→### CI/CD
   324→
   325→The project includes GitHub Actions workflows for CI/CD:
   326→
   327→- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - Runs tests, linting, and build on every PR
   328→- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` - Automated deployment (configure with your platform)
   329→
   330→### Environment-Specific Configuration
   331→
   332→#### Development
   333→```bash
   334→npm run dev
   335→```
   336→
   337→#### Production
   338→```bash
   339→npm run build
   340→npm run start
   341→```
   342→
   343→#### Monitoring
   344→
   345→- **Vercel Analytics**: Integrated for performance monitoring
   346→- **Sentry**: Configure `SENTRY_DSN` for error tracking
   347→- **Google Analytics**: Configure `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID` for user analytics
   348→
   349→---
   350→
   351→## Scripts
   352→
   353→- `npm run dev` - Start development server
   354→- `npm run build` - Build for production
   355→- `npm run start` - Start production server
   356→- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint
   357→- `npm run type-check` - Run TypeScript check
   358→- `npm run test` - Run all tests
   359→- `npm run test:unit` - Run unit tests
   360→- `npm run test:watch` - Run unit tests in watch mode
   361→- `npm run test:coverage` - Run tests with coverage report
   362→- `npm run test:e2e` - Run E2E tests

_**Agent (glm-4.7 2026-01-10T09:46:22.236Z)**_

Đã fix xong! Bây giờ bạn cần tạo function trong Supabase. Làm theo hướng dẫn:

## Bước 1: Tạo Function `get_categories_with_post_count`

1. Vào **Supabase Dashboard** → **SQL Editor**
2. Tạo query mới và paste code sau:

```sql
-- Create RPC function to get categories with post count
create or replace function get_categories_with_post_count()
returns table (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  slug text,
  description text,
  post_count bigint
)
language sql
stable
as $$
  select
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.slug,
    c.description,
    count(p.id) filter (where p.status = 'PUBLISHED') as post_count
  from categories c
  left join post_categories pc on c.id = pc.category_id
  left join posts p on pc.post_id = p.id
  group by c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description
  order by c.name;
$$;
```

3. Click **Run** để tạo function

---

## Bước 2: Fix Datetime trong Database (Nếu còn lỗi)

Nếu sau khi tạo function vẫn còn lỗi datetime, chạy query này để fix datetime format:

```sql
-- Fix datetime format for posts (update to proper ISO format)
UPDATE posts 
SET 
  published_at = CASE 
    WHEN published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 
      CASE 
        WHEN published_at::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}' THEN
          replace(published_at::text, ' ', 'T') || '.000Z'
        ELSE published_at::text
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  created_at = CASE 
    WHEN created_at::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}' THEN
      replace(created_at::text, ' ', 'T') || '.000Z'
    ELSE created_at::text
  END,
  updated_at = CASE 
    WHEN updated_at::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}' THEN
      replace(updated_at::text, ' ', 'T') || '.000Z'
    ELSE updated_at::text
  END
WHERE true;
```

## Nhận Xét Về UI Blog Thiền

### ✅ Điểm Hay

1. **Concept Zen Theme rất đẹp**:
   - Warm paper tones (#fafaf9) - cảm giác như đọc sách thật
   - Fonts Playfair Display + Merriweather - rất phù hợp "book-like aesthetic"
   - Color palette ấm, earthy (brown, amber) - tạo cảm giác bình yên

2. **Micro-interactions tốt**:
   - Fade-in animations với delay - rất smooth
   - Hover effects trên PostCard (image zoom, title color change)
   - Smooth transitions (200ms)

3. **Typography tốt**:
   - Line-height 1.7 - dễ đọc
   - Proper font hierarchy
   - Text balance utility

4. **Responsive**:
   - Mobile breakpoints tốt
   - Clamp() cho fluid typography

---

### ⚠️ Điểm Cần Cải Thiện

#### 1. **Navigation Menu Chưa Có Header Cố Định**
```typescript
// Hiện tại navigation chỉ nằm trong mỗi page
// Nên có component Header riêng để reuse
```

**Đề xuất**: Tạo `components/layout/Header.tsx` cố định ở top với:
- Logo/Brand name
- Navigation links
- Search button
- Theme toggle (nếu có)

#### 2. **Spacing Quá Lớn**
```css
/* Trong globals.css */
hr {
  margin: 4rem 0;  /* Quá nhiều khoảng trắng */
}
```

**Đề xuất**: Giảm xuống `2rem` hoặc `2.5rem`

#### 3. **PostCard Thiếu Visual Hierarchy**
```tsx
// Hiện tại categories và meta cùng kích thước
// Không có sự phân biệt rõ ràng
```

**Đề xuất**: 
- Categories: nhỏ hơn, muted color
- Meta info: có icon (calendar, clock)
- Excerpt: thêm background hoặc border-left

#### 4. **Không Có Breadcrumb**
```tsx
// Khi vào post detail, không có đường dẫn
// User không biết đang ở đâu
```

**Đề xuất**: Thêm breadcrumb component

#### 5. **Cover Image Aspect Ratio Cố Định**
```tsx
aspect-[2/1]  // Có thể không phù hợp với mọi ảnh
```

**Đề xuất**: Dùng aspect-ratio tự động hoặc object-fit variants

#### 6. **Không Có Loading Skeleton**
```tsx
// Khi load posts, chỉ hiện empty state
// Nên có skeleton khi đang fetch
```

#### 7. **Color Contrast Có thể Cải Thiện**
```css
--text-muted: #78716c;  /* #4.5 - hơi nhạt */
```

**Đề xuất**: Tăng lên `#57534e` để dễ đọc hơn

#### 8. **Mobile Experience**
- Navigation trên mobile có thể bị overflow
- Nên có hamburger menu cho mobile

---

### 💡 Gợi Ý Cải Thiện Ngay

1. **Thêm Favicon** - Hiện tại tab browser chỉ có icon mặc định

2. **Thêm Back to Top Button** - Cho long scrolling

3. **Thêm Reading Progress Bar** - Cho post detail page

4. **Optimize Images** - Dùng next/image với placeholder blur

5. **Add Dark Mode** - Theme system đã có sẵn, nên thêm toggle

  created_at: datetimeString,               /* Changed from z.string().datetime() */
  updated_at: datetimeString,               /* Changed from z.string().datetime() */

})

/**
 * Get published posts with pagination support
 *
 * Fetches all published posts from the database with their associated categories.
 * Supports cursor-based pagination for efficient navigation through large datasets.
 *
 * @param params - Pagination parameters
 * @param params.limit - Maximum number of posts to return (default: 20)
 * @param params.cursor - Pagination cursor (ISO timestamp of last post from previous page)
 *
 * @returns Paginated result containing:
 *   - `data`: Array of published posts with categories
 *   - `count`: Total number of published posts
 *   - `hasMore`: Whether more posts exist beyond this page
 *   - `nextCursor`: Cursor for next page (if hasMore is true)
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * // Get first 20 posts
 * const result1 = await getPublishedPosts({ limit: 20 })
 *
 * // Get next page
 * const result2 = await getPublishedPosts({
 *   limit: 20,
 *   cursor: result1.nextCursor
 * })
 * ```
 */
export async function getPublishedPosts(
  params: PaginationParams = {}
): Promise<PaginatedResult<PostWithCategories>>
```

## 4. Errors and Fixes

### Error 1: TypeScript datetime validation errors
**Error**: Database had datetime strings that didn't match strict ISO 8601 format expected by `z.string().datetime()`
```
Error: Invalid ISO datetime
Path: ["published_at"], ["created_at"], ["updated_at"]
```

**Fix**: Changed Zod schema to use custom validator that accepts multiple formats:
```typescript
const datetimeString = z.string().refine((val) => {
  const date = new Date(val)
  return !isNaN(date.getTime())
}, { message: 'Invalid datetime string' })
```

### Error 2: Missing database function
**Error**: `get_categories_with_post_count` function not found in Supabase
```
Error: Could not find the function public.get_categories_with_post_count without parameters in the schema cache
```

**Fix**: Created SQL migration to add the function:
```sql
create or replace function get_categories_with_post_count()
returns table (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  slug text,
  description text,
  post_count bigint
)
language sql
stable
as $
  select
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.slug,
    c.description,
    count(p.id) filter (where p.status = 'PUBLISHED') as post_count
  from categories c
  left join post_categories pc on c.id = pc.category_id
  left join posts p on pc.post_id = p.id
  group by c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description
  order by c.name;
$;
```

UI redesign hoàn thành. Đây là những thay đổi đã thực hiện:

## Các trang đã được redesign

### 1. Homepage (`app/(public)/page.tsx`)
- Hero section với gradient background
- Decorative elements (animated pulse dot, gradient lines)
- Tiêu đề lớn hơn và bold hơn (text-5xl → text-7xl)
- Stats display với icon ✦
- Navigation được cải thiện với layout justified

### 2. PostCard Component (`components/public/PostCard.tsx`)
- Gradient border effect khi hover
- Better typography (title: text-2xl → text-3xl)
- Icon SVG cho metadata (calendar, clock)
- Top border separator khi không có categories
- Smooth transitions (duration-500)

### 3. Category Page (`app/(public)/category/[slug]/page.tsx`)
- Gradient background
- Decorative elements giống homepage
- Post count badge
- Better visual hierarchy

### 4. Search Page (`app/(public)/search/page.tsx`)
- Gradient background
- Decorative elements
- Larger headings (text-4xl → text-5xl)
- Better empty states

### 5. Danh Muc Page (`app/(public)/danh-muc/page.tsx`)
- Grid layout (2 columns trên desktop)
- Card design cho categories
- Gradient hover effects
- Better footer với card-style quote

### 6. Post Detail Page (`app/(public)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx`)
- Gradient background
- Icon SVG cho publish date
- Better spacing and animations
- Card-style footer quote

## Validation
- ✓ TypeScript: No errors
- ✓ ESLint: No warnings
